summary: Mako Mining Corp., a Vancouver-domiciled gold miner listed on Nasdaq and TSX-V, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated September 18, 2026, disclosing equity incentive grants rather than a transactional event. The company awarded an aggregate 60,000 stock options to two employees, 30,000 each, at an exercise price of C$13.92 per common share, equal to the five-day VWAP on the TSXV prior to grant, with a five-year term expiring September 17, 2031, under its Omnibus Incentive Plan. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal terms are implicated; this is routine compensation disclosure carrying no special-situation or arbitrage angle.
